spans.s: (sometimes incorrectly written रुग्न॑) broken, bent, shattered, injured, checked, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
रुग्—अन्वित mfn. attended with pain, painful.
रुग्—आर्त mfn. afflicted with pain, ill, Veṇīs.
रुग्—दाह m. a kind of fever, Bhpr.
रुग्—भय n. fear of disease, MW.
रुग्—भेषज n. ‘disease-drug’, any medicine or drug, VarBṛS.
रुग्—विनिश्चय m. (also called रोग-व्˚ or माधव-निदान or simply निदान) ‘determination of disease’, N. of wk. by Mādhava (treating of the causes and diagnosis of 80 kinds of disease).

रुग्ण—ता, f. and रुग्ण—त्व, n. brokenness, crookedness, MW.
 infirmity, sickness, disease, ib.

रुग्ण—ता, f. and रुग्ण—त्व, n. brokenness, crookedness, MW.
 infirmity, sickness, disease, ib.
रुग्ण—रय mfn. checked in an onset, foiled in an attack, ib.
